Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Movement of mobile plant
Risk: Personal injury
Protective Coatings.controls:
Site Inductions
Use designated access routes
Obey all signage and policies
Ensure all mandatory PPE is worn, including hard hat, safety glasses, safety boots, hi-vis clothing and gloves.
Do not walk near mobile plant without making eye contact
Approach if safe to do so
Place a restricted access zone and use a spotter as required

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Movement of mobile plant/manual handling
Risk: Personal injury/muscle strain
Protective Coatings.controls:
Obey all signage and directions
Use correct lifting techniques and mechanical aids where possible
Do not lift over 20kg alone, use two men or mechanical aid

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Trip/electrical hazards 
Risk: Electric shock, injury
Protective Coatings.controls:
Ensure all electrical equipment is tagged monthly
Ensure all leads/lines are above head height
Use electrical lead hooks to hand leads

Protective Coatings.job_step: Daily inspection and maintenance of machinery
Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Damage to surrounds 
Risk: Injury, damages
Protective Coatings.controls:
Prestart checks and inspect all equipment/hoses/tags
Remedy defects where necessary
Sign logbooks daily before use

Protective Coatings.job_step: Exclude other trades from work area
Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Working near others
Risk: Minor irritation, service clash
Protective Coatings.controls:
Ensure other trades are aware of operations 
Place a restricted access zone if necessary 
Attend safety and subcontractor meetings

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Hot surfaces
Risk: Burns, Cuts, Eye Damage, Fire, other trade/public interaction resulting in injury/death
Protective Coatings.controls:
Allow work area to cool off to eliminate burns.
Erect welding screens to protect other workers in the area.
Set up restricted access zones with barriers and erect restricted access zone signage. 
Power tool protection guards to be in place. 
Firefighting equipment to be readily available in case of fire from hot work. For example, fire blanket, fire extinguisher, water. 
 Double face protection required for cutting and grinding works. Gloves to prevent burns. Project specific PPE 
Hot works permit to be completed prior to hot works

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Cutting of lightweight construction materials 
Risk: Manual handling Injuries, amputation, respiratory irritation
Protective Coatings.controls:
Wear all required PPE including hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, safety boots, high-vis clothing.
Keep work area clean and remove offcuts from ground
Use correct manual handling while moving and cutting materials, do not lift large pieces with one person only
Ensure all electrical equipment is tagged and is used by competent persons
Obtain hot works permit if using angle grinders
Place an exclusion zone and use a spotter as required
Cut in an appropriate ventilated area and follow correct operating procedures

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Lifting and fixing lightweight construction material
Risk: Manual handling injuries, striking personnel/objects, drilling near services
Protective Coatings.controls:
Wear all required PPE including hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, safety boots, high-vis clothing.
Keep work area clean and remove offcuts from ground
Use correct manual handling while moving and fixing materials, do not lift large pieces with one person only
Ensure all electrical equipment is tagged and is used by competent persons
Obtain required permits
Place a restricted access zone and use a spotter as required
Follow correct operating procedures

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Cutting and fixing mesh 
Risk: Ignition of flammable sources, cuts, abrasions
Protective Coatings.controls:
Wear all required PPE including hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, safety boots, high-vis clothing. 
Ensure all electrical equipment is tagged monthly and used by competent persons 
Obtain hot works permit for use of grinder or pinning machine. Do not use near flammable material. 
Place a restricted access zone and use a spotter where deemed necessary 
Keep work area clean and remove all pins and offcuts from the ground

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Mixing lightweight construction materials
Risk: manual handling injury, respiratory irritation, entaglement
Protective Coatings.controls:
Wear all required PPE including hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, safety boots, high-vis clothing, and dust masks
Use correct manual handling techniques 
Take care to prevent spillage 
Never insert hands or solid objects into mixer. Ensure grate covers mixing zone while machine is operational

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Spraying lightweight construction materials 
Risk: slips, trips, falls, respiratory irritation
Protective Coatings.controls:
Wear all required PPE including hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, safety boots, high-vis clothing, and dust masks
Ensure other workers are excluded from the area, place a restricted access zone and use a spotter where required
Area must be well ventilated and protected from the elements
Minimise overspray and maintain housekeeping practices 
Use multiple coats to ensure product adhesion and minimise wet mix falling to ground 
Area must be well ventilated

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Deactivating machines 
Risk: Slips, trips, spills, contamination
Protective Coatings.controls:
Ensure all waste is contained and disposed in provided receptacles. 
Contain spills to local area and prevent contamination. Use available spill kits
Clean work area and machines

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Disposing of waste 
Risk: Manual handling injuries, contamination
Protective Coatings.controls:
Ensure all wastewater disposed in suitable discharge points 
Use correct manual handling techniques
All solid waste in bins provided 
Separate and recycle materials wherever possible

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Housekeeping 
Risk: Manual handling injuries, spills, trips, contamination
Protective Coatings.controls:
Clean work area each day and place all solid waste in bins provided 
Flush machine with water at the end of each shift 
Pack/clean/secure tools and equipment

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Site incident/injury 
Risk: Injury or death
Protective Coatings.controls:
Follow Emergency Response Plan attached and site-specific emergency procedures 
Stop work immediately 
Immediately alert the supervisor/first aider
Call 000

Protective Coatings.hazards:
Hazard: Site emergency
Risk: Injury or death
Protective Coatings.controls:
Work stops immediately 
Follow site-specific Emergency Response Plan and Procedures
Evacuate the site to the nearest emergency assembly point and await further instruction
